extracted.name: Cherry bakewell cocktail
extracted.description: Turn the flavours of cherry bakewell into a cocktail with amaretto and cherry cordial. Finish with a maraschino cherry for the ultimate kitsch beverage
instruction_lines: Fill two tall glasses with ice cubes. Combine the amaretto, cordial and lemon juice in a small jug, then divide between the glasses. Top with lemonade, then stir well. Garnish with a maraschino cherry, if you like.
